title: C_DestroyObject missing encrypt_active scan
description: C_DestroyObject scans all sessions and clears sign_active, verify_active, decrypt_active when those ops reference the deleted key. It does NOT clear encrypt_active/encrypt_key. A caller that destroys a key while C_EncryptUpdate is in progress will later call C_EncryptFinal referencing a freed key handle -- use-after-free or NULL deref.
